contract_question: OFFLINE policy replay over VERIFIED per-row probe matrices (batch_probe+governance verified primitives): does a NO-PEEK cost-accounted kernel-FEEDBACK-sequential policy (selects next (cand,action) using only outcomes of probes it has ALREADY spent budget on) beat random/BM25/source-rank/action-sweep on median failed-probes-before-closure_or_exact_gap by >=2x OR closed_or_exact_gap@5 by >=20pp, with 0 false-ratify, 0 wrong-target-kind, all closures pinned-replay, no hand edits? (oracle policy = upper-bound only, never the claim)
rationale_short: Cold-review re-spec: cost-accounted offline-first removes the oracle-contamination my batched harness had. Honest p~0.35: kernel-FEEDBACK-sequential with NO pre-probe signal is ~random on early probes; its only edge is post-failure adaptation (exact-failed->simp; bad-cand deprioritize). In-grid closures exist (T2P_42 5/19) so testable, but sparse; BM25/action-sweep may already capture it (FM2). Not pre-conceding (anti solver-pessimism); not optimistic.
